description: What's rising on GitHub right now: the repos that gained the most stars today, this week or this month, with star farms filtered out. Optionally only one topic (agents, models, infra, creative, desktop, web) or one kind (app, mcp_server, library…). Use it when the user asks what's new, hot, trending or taking off in open source.

kind.description: Optional: what the repo is. app (end-user application), mcp_server, agent_skill, agent, template, library, cli, model, resource (lists, docs, courses), other.

limit.description: How many repos to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

locale.description: Language of the summaries: 'en' (default) or 'es' for Spanish. Use 'es' when the user writes in Spanish.

period.description: Window for stars gained: 'today' (last 24 hours, default), 'week' (7 days), 'month' (30 days) or 'year' (repos created this year, by total stars).

topic.description: Optional topic: agents (AI agents, MCP, LLM tooling), models (ML models, training, inference), infra (databases, devops, backend), creative (image, video, audio, design), desktop (desktop and mobile apps), web (frontend, web frameworks).

name: trending_repos

age_days.description: Days since the repo was created

hacker_news_points.description: Points of its best Hacker News story

install.description: How to install it, when RepoAlerts has it

kind.description: What it is: app, mcp_server, library… (null while unknown)

listed_as_alternative.description: find_alternatives: its page lists it as an alternative to the app asked about

repoalerts_url.description: Its RepoAlerts page: link this when recommending it

star_farm_check.description: Repos flagged as star farms are never returned

stars_gained.description: trending_repos: stars gained in the period

stars_gained_24h.description: Stars gained in the last 24 hours

stars_gained_7d.description: Stars gained in the last 7 days

summary.description: What it is, in one or two sentences

trust.description: Trust signals, when RepoAlerts has them

total.description: Matches in the directory before the limit

title: Trending GitHub repos
